task_instance: Given a sample project brief (migrating company payroll to a third-party SaaS vendor, PayCo, within 3 months, with tight staffing and a hard compliance deadline), produce a prioritized risk register following the skill's format: for each risk, Description/Likelihood/Impact/Risk Level/Mitigation/Owner/Status, with Risk Level derived from the skill's Likelihood x Impact matrix, plus a prioritized summary grouping risks by level.
evidence: Created project_brief.md describing the sample scenario. Created risk_register.md containing an 8-row risk register covering Operational, Financial, Compliance, Strategic, Reputational, and Security categories (as listed in SKILL.md), each with Description/Likelihood/Impact/Risk Level/Mitigation/Owner/Status, plus a Prioritized Summary section grouping risks into Critical/High/Medium. Verified correctness by writing a small Python script (run via `python3`) that reconstructed the skill's Likelihood x Impact matrix as a dict and checked every row's claimed Risk Level against the matrix-derived expected value: all 8 rows printed 'OK' and the script printed 'ALL_CONSISTENT'. This is a pure text/reasoning deliverable (no external data, network, or credentials needed), so it was fully achievable in the offline, no-network sandbox using only already-installed python3 and standard file I/O. Files produced: project_brief.md, risk_register.md, result.json (all under the work directory).
